finalText: Verification passes. Migrated the remaining 12 stragglers (in `analytics`, `orders`, `billing`, `support`, `catalog`, and `accounts` packages) from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, left `cache.query` and the vendored `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched, and confirmed with `node verify.js` that every call site moved and nothing else did.
